question: Which classes of celestial and semi-divine beings are further included in this vision?
premises: Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas are named
The goddess is addressed as beloved
inference: The vision further includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
uncertainties: The syntactic function of this list depends on the surrounding verses.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas, O beloved.
